Dial two-thread probe v2

Open this tool in two separate ChatGPT threads in the same browser profile. Keep both frames open. Copy results from each frame. This probe does not establish feature support on its own.








Sequence: send nonce from both frames; hold in A and check contention in B; release and reverse; hold in A then click transfer in B, listening for Radio Paradise; reverse; repeat with A backgrounded. Close the lock holder frame, reopen this tool, then check the lock from the other frame.



Results include UTC times, browser, frame origin and this resource version. Mark each audible outcome yourself when reviewing both logs.
